scenarios.notes: Windows Codex confirmed the installed and loaded README status was v0.1.7.
Stayed in review-only maintenance mode, did not enter product discovery, and did not mutate files. It found useful documentation issues.
Triggered Diagnostic Start and did not expose superpowers or host-specific helper skills.
Did not enter final PRD, Roadmap, or Implementation Plan, but still promoted candidate positioning and target user language too strongly before explicit user acceptance.
PowerShell packaging docs and eval-runs/.git/tmp exclusions were visible. dist/ was only indirectly covered and should be directly listed in the packaging exclusion rule.

key_findings: v0.1.7 was correctly installed and loaded in Windows Codex.
The maintenance negative-control mutation problem was closed.
The helper-skill visibility drift was closed for the tested P3 prompt.
User-gate drift improved but remains partially open in multi-turn PRD draft behavior.
Packaging docs should explicitly list dist/ in the install zip exclusion list.
Evaluation docs should clarify that v0.1.7 has patched run-01 and now needs patch verification rerun rather than generic patch-and-rerun wording.
evals.json version metadata can be misread as package version rather than strict-suite version.
recommended_actions: Patch README packaging exclusion list to directly include dist/.
Patch evaluation-package Next Evidence wording to say v0.1.7 patch verification rerun.
Clarify evals.json metadata by separating suite_version from current_package_version or documenting that version is suite-level.
Tighten SKILL.md user-gate rule so candidate target users, MVP scope, and positioning cannot appear as confirmed facts inside PRD draft sections before user acceptance.
